figurative_meaning_en: Something precious or the best of its kind in a positive sense
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কন্যা তার কাছে একটি রত্ন।
example_sentences_in_english: His daughter is a gem to him.
This award is the jewel of the nation.
history: Derived from Sanskrit 'ratna' meaning jewel; 'Bharat Ratna' is India's highest civilian award established in 1954.
note: Often used in compounds to denote value and excellence in Bengali literature and daily speech.
